# With a stability of 5 (5 windows, offset 2), CDP writes a silent first frame (its stability buffer's first place, never filled), then each analysis window one frame late, filtered by the peaks found most often over the 5 windows up to the 3 after it (windows 0 to 1 by the first filter, designed at window 4). At its file's end it filters windows 10 to 11 with its last filter and drops window 9 (write_last_focu_buffers): a stream, 6144 samples late, which has no end, matches the first 1024 samples, up to where frame 10, the first CDP writes otherwise, starts to sound.
